It sorts the three item texts by their position on the opening screen, then computes the j/k moves from that order. This handles finding order that depends on record id. The open question always sorts last because of NEEDS_ORDER. README now has a paragraph on finished efforts: when an effort counts as finished, that it sorts last with a dimmed tab, and that it shows "All N tasks done" on the Active tab with no filter.
